notes.title: Hello, tell about the mechanics of the jump!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! the game was released! we get the first feedback, and the main problem that you face is the impossibility of jumping. In order to jump in this game, you need to accelerate well! But to accelerate, you need to press the Shift-Shift-space! And it's better to have a processor from intel for this game, i3-i5. good luck!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28558718/05d0e94f3a16e93922092df5cc8613906a47af44.jpg[/img]
